name: vc-fix
description: Agentic bug lifecycle for Virto Commerce — project setup, bug filing, autonomous bug fixing, and fix verification. Ships 7 agents, 13 skills, 5 commands. A focused subset of vc-qa's bug-lifecycle slice, packaged as an independent plugin inside the same repo (references the repo's shared knowledge/, .claude/rules/, config.js, scripts/lib in place; its repo-routing logic is self-contained in skills/qa-fix-routing/, no dependency on ci/).
